Intel Corp is a for-profit public company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, trading under ticker INTC with CIK 0000050863. Its website describes an "Intel Inside - Built for AI" positioning, saying the company delivers AI at scale across cloud, data center, edge, and client with hardware and software solutions.

The site also mentions a Googlebook built on an Intel platform, with performance, graphics, battery, and connectivity engineered to work as one. No other specific AI products are named in the provided material.

The company has a California law exposure count of 281. No cases, products, or MCP servers are listed for Intel Corp in the provided data.
